limitations: Only four simple outcome-independent member orders are tested.
Batch formation, worker assignment, and linear marginal service cost remain fixed to E82.
Compact output retains aggregate, configuration, metric, and worst-profile summaries rather than every per-profile record.
The audit reuses E79's stratified profiles, independent Bernoulli paths, and recursive E70 grids.
Aggregate comparisons repeat stochastic paths across orders and configurations and are not independent Monte Carlo samples.
model: Hold E82 exact streaming batch formation, launches, and total work fixed while changing the outcome-independent member evaluation order.

order_policy_definitions.newest_first: Evaluate newest checkpoint first, then move backward.
order_policy_definitions.newest_oldest: Alternate newest, oldest, second newest, second oldest.
order_policy_definitions.oldest_first: Evaluate retained members in checkpoint order; reproduces E82.
order_policy_definitions.oldest_newest: Alternate oldest, newest, second oldest, second newest.
